info.description: The MVR framework defines what to assess; the MVR API is the official engine that computes it. Self-serve MVR API Starter checkout: https://africanmarketos.com/checkout/starter. Access guide and governed requests: https://africanmarketos.com/get-api-key Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR), published by African Market OS, evaluates whether evidence supports market trust, permission to operate, embeddedness, stakeholder and guardian readiness, reciprocity, local legitimacy, market belonging, and a safe next step before MVP, market entry, pilot, partnership, investment, or scale. v6.32.0 MVR Engine. Additive dual-lane runtime: public_reality + local_relational_assessment + reconciled_assessment, deterministic ROI, dual-profile governance, entity-resolution preflight, modality-aware completeness/audit, compiled_evidence ingestion, provenance-ledger validation, telemetry translation, gap planning, market leak scanning, and validation snapshot metadata. Public non-commercial sandbox evaluation is available with X-API-Key: mvr-demo-key-2026; sandbox calls are rate-limited, client_safe only, full_advisory only, illustrative_only, and not for production. Send X-Response-Profile: strict_calibrated only with a licensed production key for fail-closed institutional responses. See /v1/schema for full documentation.

boundaries: Evidence and decision-governance layer, not a general market-data feed.
Public sandbox outputs are not production verdicts, approvals, certifications, underwriting decisions, or legal opinions.

x-compatibility-policy.principle: No output may claim a decision level, confidence level, category fit, or scope stronger than verified evidence permits.

x-calibration-coverage-guidance.scope: Strict calibration is manifest/asset scoped. A sector public-reality asset, a route model, and a country/archetype decision path can have different readiness states.
x-calibration-coverage-guidance.strict_mode_interpretation: When strict_calibrated returns calibration_status missing, failed, stale, or manifest_hash_mismatch, treat the result as fail-closed calibration coverage, not as proof that the submitted structured_values were ignored or that the entity is weak.
x-calibration-coverage-guidance.public_reality_note: MVR_PUBLIC_REALITY_CONFIG validates sector/archetype public-reality weighting. Localized decision authority still depends on direct local evidence, privacy_envelope validity, sample metadata, threshold assets, and strict manifests.
reviewer_diagnostic: Inspect local_relational_assessment dimensions to verify evidence discrimination.
Inspect decision_reliability.calibration_status and blocking_gates before interpreting the headline verdict.
Use authenticated GET /v1/calibration-health?coverage=full for the active deployment before claiming strict coverage.
x-calibration-coverage-guidance.structured_values_scale: Canonical structured_values are 0-100. Unambiguous 0-1 fractional payloads are normalized to 0-100 for agent safety, but production integrations should send 0-100 or set structured_values_scale explicitly.

x-modality-examples.public_osint: Use public_metrics with evidence_origin:'public_osint'. Read reconciled_assessment first, then public_reality for entity-scale interpretation.
x-modality-examples.field_research: Use structured_values on field items. Read reconciled_assessment first, then local_relational_assessment for zone-level interpretation.
x-modality-examples.corporate_telemetry: Use evidence_origin:'corporate_telemetry' or collection_method:'corporate_telemetry' for proxy-derived internal data. The engine routes it into the local lane with capped confidence and explicit proxy transparency.
x-modality-examples.compiled_evidence: Use mode:'compiled_evidence' with compiled_pack lanes from compiled_pack_registry. You may nest legacy evidence_pack[] inside compiled_pack; the worker maps it into localized_observed_pack (or public lane when pack_type indicates public). Items with full provenance_ledger use compiled_evidence validation; others use evidence_backed rules.
x-modality-examples.mixed: Mixed packs reconcile both lanes. Public facts do not impersonate local truth; local friction does not erase entity-scale reality.
x-modality-examples.abstention: Scope-limited abstentions are returned when localized claims are unsupported by direct field evidence.

EvidenceItem.description: Extensible source metadata. Unknown item-level field names receive non-blocking input_interpretation notices on successful licensed evidence responses; acceptance is not proof that a control was evaluated. Suggested names require checking source facts and are never applied automatically. Nested open metadata is not recursively classified by this notice mechanism.

source_date.description: Real ISO date or timestamp with timezone. This records source age; it does not replace the collection/freshness date required for typed scoring.

sampling_method.description: Use census for a declared complete finite population; this does not override weighted sample admission.

guardian_tier.description: Guardian role classification, not an adverse score setting. Only guardian evidence activates guardian-specific analysis; stance, observed substance and actual veto authority determine applicable gates. A tier change need not change the verdict.

stance.description: Declared stakeholder stance. Opposed or hostile load-bearing evidence requires stakeholder review even when linked as direct_support. This does not rewrite the factual claim relationship or authenticate the source.

verification_status.description: Caller declaration, not independent verification. No confidence boost from this label. Disputed evidence blocks authorization until reconciled or segregated.

evidence_geography.description: Use a supported ISO country code, not a country name. The item country is the source geography, not an assertion of target-market fit.

freshness_date.description: ISO calendar date for the collection/freshness alias. Must satisfy the same runtime date checks as freshness_date.

expired.description: Literal true requires review for decision-relevant evidence, regardless of a recent source date.

structured_values.description: Ingestible field-observed MVR dimension values. Canonical production scale is 0-100. Accepted core keys: permission, trust, belonging, embeddedness, reciprocity, cultural_fit, guardian_strength, continuity, channel_permission, infrastructural_intimacy, absence_sensitivity, narrative_looping, whispered_credibility, fractal_trust, cultural_calibration. Agent-safety note: if at least two valid core dimensions on the same evidence item are all between 0 and 1, the worker normalizes them from fractional 0-1 to 0-100 before scoring; production clients should still send 0-100 to avoid ambiguity. Do not submit derived concepts such as evidence_completeness, market_carry, local_legitimacy; submit the listed underlying dimensions instead.
structured_values.x-fraction-scale-normalization: unambiguous 0-1 core-dimension rows are normalized to 0-100

structured_values_scale.description: Optional hint for agents. Use '0-1 fraction' only when sending fractional structured_values; otherwise omit and send canonical 0-100 scores.

behavioral_values.description: Supported on corporate telemetry. The current check pairs high consumer field permission with low 30_day_active_retention_percent under the configured maturity policy, caps scale at pilot_ready and emits severe_evidence_dissonance_survey_vs_telemetry in scale_recommendation.blueprint_codes. A lower existing pilot_only ceiling need not change. This is not a general trust/churn causal inference; unspecified churn, retention and frequency keys are rejected.

structured_values_provenance.description: Per-dimension map using exact keys present in structured_values, for example {trust:"observed",permission:"imputed"}. input_score_provenance is not a blanket override and is rejected as an unknown dimension. Provenance affects admitted support and weights; other gates may keep headline scores or confidence unchanged.

human_reviewed.description: Caller-declared review required for AI-extracted material before strict or decisive use. Not identity verification, a signature, authenticated reviewer approval or independent source verification.

reviewed_by.description: Caller-supplied reviewer name for AI-extracted material when human_reviewed=true. The name is not authenticated; supplying it does not establish identity, independence or that review occurred.

human_review.description: Optional structured review record; may include by/reviewer_id, status, and reviewed_at.

organ_attestation.description: MVR Examiner or other organ-produced evidence attestation. The deterministic kernel treats unreviewed organ evidence as imputed/non-decisive.

_verifier_attestation.description: Verifier-organ attestation for extraction review. Internal/audit use; unreviewed AI extraction remains non-decisive.

uncertainty_envelope.description: Named 0-1 components influence evidence weighting. interval_80, score_point_estimate and basis are caller-supplied descriptions, not calibrated output intervals or gate overrides. Unknown component names are rejected; uniform reweighting or another cap can leave headline confidence unchanged.

survey_payload.description: For survey evidence, include survey_name, population_definition, sampling_method and sample_frame. Panel and census are accepted sampling methods. Census additionally requires consistent declared population_size and sample_size; it never bypasses weighted admission or establishes representativeness.

payload.description: Generic typed evidence payload, including telemetry or evaluation details. Retains supplied context only; prose does not become observed numeric scores or authenticated proof. Evaluation payloads need evaluator_name.

collection_date.description: ISO calendar date for the collection/freshness alias. Must satisfy the same runtime date checks as freshness_date.

variance_anomaly_detected.description: Caller-declared variance anomaly, not a numeric variance score. True constrains the decision ceiling and requires source corroboration.

bot_or_farm_probability.description: Caller-supplied finite 0-1 bot/farm-risk estimate from an upstream assessment. AMOS does not calculate this probability from source prose.

data_integrity.description: Optional declared integrity signals, honored for flat evidence and compiled lanes. Unknown keys, null, invalid types and out-of-range values are rejected. Omission or an empty object means no assessment supplied, not a clean bill of health. In client_safe read scale_recommendation.blueprint_codes and decision_authorization, including data_integrity_gate.blocking_alerts when blocked. data_quality.integrity_alerts is an internal/full diagnostic path and may be omitted by projection. A confidence or candidate label alone is not the gate result. These are configured review controls, not independently verified anti-fraud detection.

claims.description: Optional explicit target claims and source-specific support links. Reuses the governed claim-audit vocabulary. Public links are caller declarations, never authenticated reviewer attestations.

evidence_id.description: Must identify an item in this complete evidence pack.

locator.description: Specific page, cell or section. A locator is not proof.

review_event_id.description: Only the licensed review service can check this event; ignored as authority by public preflight.

analysis_date.description: Declared analysis calendar date or ISO timestamp with timezone. No later than today in analysis_timezone.

analysis_timezone.description: IANA analysis timezone; defaults to UTC.

context_freshness_window_days.description: Caller-declared maximum evidence age, not a calibrated universal cutoff.

geo_match_tolerance.description: Declare the actual decision geography. Do not widen it to obtain a verdict.

unit_economics.description: Enterprise blueprint: LTV/CAC, runway, margin - gates scaling verdict when structurally unprofitable.

financial_context.description: Optional unit economics overlay (CAC/LTV/runway/margin). Advisory; does not mutate relational scores. Treasury-grade models still required.

competitive_context.description: Optional incumbent share, switching costs, price-war risk. Pair with /v1/competitive-wargame for scenarios.

behavioral_signals.description: Optional revealed-preference telemetry (DAU, churn fraction). Complements interview-derived evidence.

operational_readiness.description: Optional execution SLAs/uptime/fulfillment proxies for internal capacity.

sentiment_velocity.description: Optional wave-over-wave deltas on trust/permission to detect momentum vs static snapshots.

b2b_context.description: Procurement/SLA/RFP signals where relational consumer metrics are weak proxies.

scaling_physics.description: Expected intimacy decay at scale; friction coefficient for pilot->mass transitions.

market_education_profile.description: Ignorance vs hostility: discovery/education phases for category creation.

backtest_mode.description: When true, response echoes backtest_mode and optional t0_date for replay transparency.

t0_date.description: Backtest as-of date echoed when backtest_mode is true.

ActionAuthorizationBoundary.description: Required fail-closed action boundary, not a signed permission capability. Missing, malformed or unknown boundaries must be treated as BLOCKED by the host. This release cannot emit ALLOWED. Independent authority is required outside AMOS. Legacy authorized output-use labels never lift this boundary.

assessment_executed.description: False on pre-assessment output-mode rejection. Absence is not evidence that no assessment ran.

field.description: Caller field that mismatched server-persisted decision lineage.

strict_eligible.description: Legacy schema-and-authorized-review eligibility, not independent verification or execution permission.

governance_history_boundary.description: Forward-only index. Missing older events do not prove absence of activity.

history_complete.description: True when this scan has no continuation, including its final empty page. Accumulate all preceding pages for complete history.

strict_calibrated_ready.description: Full manifested corpus plus representative checks; never smoke-only readiness.

strict_smoke_calibration_ready.description: Representative subset only. Does not override a false full_corpus_attested.

proposed_verdict.description: Alias of target_verdict for client compatibility.

GovernanceDisplay.description: Dashboard-oriented join of model pacing (scale_recommendation), formal API gates (decision_authorization), and reliability ceilings (decision_reliability). Prefer dashboard_lines for primary UI copy.

field_legend.description: Glossary entries keyed by field name (decision_authorization, decision_reliability, governance_display, scale_recommendation); each value has path, label, ui_hint, scope.

model_scale_signal.description: velocity, capital_deployment_cap_percent, interpretation - mirrors scale_recommendation signal, not permission to execute.

formal_authorization.description: status, blocking_gates, authorized_use, not_authorized_use - same semantics as decision_authorization.

reliability_constraints.description: level, authorized_for_decision, not_authorized_for - same semantics as decision_reliability ceilings.

dashboard_lines.description: Human-readable lines for governance strip / hero messaging.
